name: Respiratory Bronchiolitis-Interstitial Lung Disease Syndrome
aliases: Respiratory Bronchiolitis with Interstitial Lung Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No formal consensus criteria; diagnosis based on clinical, radiologic, and histopathologic correlation

criteria.description: Current or former cigarette smoking history
Chronic cough and dyspnea on exertion
High-resolution CT showing centrilobular nodules and ground-glass opacities predominantly in upper lobes
Lung biopsy demonstrating pigmented macrophages in respiratory bronchioles with mild interstitial inflammation and fibrosis
Exclusion of other interstitial lung diseases such as desquamative interstitial pneumonia and hypersensitivity pneumonitis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of smoking history, compatible clinical symptoms, characteristic HRCT findings, and supportive histopathology with exclusion of other ILDs
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multidisciplinary discussion including pulmonology, radiology, and pathology

common.symptomName: Diffuse reticular or finely nodular infiltrations

laboratory: Mildly elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in some cases
Normal or mildly reduced pulmonary function tests with restrictive pattern and reduced DLCO
imaging: HRCT showing centrilobular nodules, patchy ground-glass opacities, and mild fibrosis predominantly in upper lobes
Absence of honeycombing or extensive fibrosis
genetic: No known genetic mutations associated; disease strongly linked to smoking exposure
other: Bronchoalveolar lavage showing increased pigmented macrophages
Lung biopsy confirming respiratory bronchiolitis with interstitial inflammation

distinguishingFeatures: More diffuse alveolar involvement with abundant macrophages
More extensive ground-glass opacities on imaging
More prominent lymphocytic alveolitis on BAL
Basal and subpleural predominant fibrosis with honeycombing on HRCT
Progressive restrictive lung disease with poor prognosis

references: American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society International Multidisciplinary Consensus Classification of the Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias, 2013
King TE Jr, et al. Idiopathic interstitial pneumonias. Lancet. 2011
Orphanet: Respiratory bronchiolitis-interstitial lung disease syndrome (ORPHA:79127)
